The binomial theorem for positive integer n states that (a+b)n=(n0)anb0+(n1)an−1b1+(n2)an−2b2+…+(nn)a0bn.

By substituting a=5, b=x, and n=7, we obtain (5+x)7=(70)(5)7(x)0+(71)(5)7−1(x)1+(72)(5)7−2(x)2+⋯=1(5)7+7(5)6(x)1+21(5)5(x)2+⋯=78125+7(15625)(x)+21(3125)(x2)+⋯=78125+109375x+65625x2+⋯.

So, for small x, we have (5+x)7≈78125+109375x+65625x2.

Finally, we substitute x=−0.03 into the above approximation of (5+x)7: (4.97)7=(5+(−0.03))7≈78125+109375(−0.03)+65625(−0.03)2=78125+109375(−0.03)+65625(0.0009)=78125−3281.25+59.0625≈74902.81, rounded to two decimal places.
